title: Geometric transport of an evaluation-normalized signed Tate comparison
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P of [def-pur-conventions], a natural number n with P.level=n+1, the finite coefficient ring A=O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1)), and a proof that ell^(n+1) annihilates A. For every k-scheme X with structure morphism a, write L_X(r) and M_X(r) for the signed etale and pro-etale A-module sheaves, and nu_X for site comparison, as defined in [def-pur-signed-twist-site-transport-data]. Let b_X(j):nu_X^*L_X(j) ≅ M_X(j), j≥0, satisfy the specified root-tensor normalization [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent]. Let q_X(r) be any family of signed comparison isomorphisms agreeing with b in nonnegative degrees and satisfying the actual evaluation equation of [def-pur-signed-twist-site-transport-data]. There is a family tau_(v,a,r):v_pro^* M_X(r) ≅ M_Xprime(r) for every map v:Xprime→X of k-schemes, with the prescribed root-generator formula at all nonnegative degrees, preservation of dual evaluation, and the actual canonical identity and composition constraints. For every negative degree r, v_pro^*q_X(r) followed by tau_(v,a,r) equals the canonical comparison mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], followed by nu_Xprime^* of the prescribed etale pullback isomorphism and q_Xprime(r). Precisely the predicates SignedSiteGeometricLaws and SignedSitePullbackSquare of the cited definition hold; no multiplication or theta normalization is asserted.

proof.text: Let $v:X'\to X$ and $d>0$. Obtain the positive square from the root-induced etale maps, the same-root site square [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison], and the projection-induced theta identification and its scheme square [lem-amb-tate-root-projection-reduction]. Tensor iteration gives the root-normalized nonnegative comparisons of [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent], the comparison $k_v$ with its identity/composition laws [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], and the evaluation-compatible etale pullbacks [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Pullback of duals is the transpose of pulled evaluation [lem-pur-ringed-site-finite-free-dual-pullback]; relative tensor pullback is natural [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor]. Pair the two proposed maps on degree $-d$ with the common degree $d$ map. Substitution of the two evaluation formulas of Step 2 and the positive pullback square gives the same pulled evaluation on both routes. Explicitly, on a pulled local basis $e_d$ put $f_d=q^+_{X,d}(e_d)$ and $e'_d=\tau^e_{v,d}(v_e^*e_d)$. The positive square says that both positive routes take $e_d$ to $f'_d=q^+_{X',d}(e'_d)$. Each negative route takes $e_d^\vee$ to the functional with value $1$ on $f'_d$, hence to $(f'_d)^\vee$. Here the naturality of $k_v$ applies also to the basis map from the coefficient unit; on constant coefficients its component is the unit identification. Thus the two negative routes agree on a local basis, proving the stated square with exactly the specified dual maps. For an identity or a composite of scheme maps, the two candidate negative maps again pair with the same positive map to the same evaluation; uniqueness gives the identity and composition laws. This also proves the requested compatibility with dual evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem signedTwistGeometricCompatibility (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (hlevel : P.level = n + 1)
    (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : P.signedSiteCoefficient n) = 0)
    (b : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (_a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (P.signedSiteCoefficient n)) X).obj
        (P.signedSiteEtale n hA X (k : ℤ)) ≅ P.signedSitePro n X (k : ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      IsFiniteTateSiteComparison P.coefficients.l P.extension n X n hA k (b X a k))
    (q : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (_a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (r : ℤ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (P.signedSiteCoefficient n)) X).obj
        (P.signedSiteEtale n hA X r) ≅ P.signedSitePro n X r)
    (hq : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      q X a k = b X a k)
    (he : P.SignedSiteEvaluation n hA q) :
    ∃ τ : P.SignedSiteGeometric n,
      P.SignedSiteGeometricLaws n τ ∧ P.SignedSitePullbackSquare n hlevel hA τ q
